manifest.mobileLab: 390x844, device scale 1, CPU 4x, CDP throttling RTT 150ms, download 200KB/s, upload 100KB/s
manifest.cache: Each iteration uses a new isolated context with browser cache enabled; cold initial navigation, warm immediate same-URL navigation; no CDN bypass.
manifest.physicalAndroid: Unavailable in this environment; required physical low-end Android gate is blocked/unmet.
manifest.syntheticCard: Not run; no real dedicated non-secret synthetic card token was discoverable from the public pages without credentials.
manifest.sampling: 10 cold/warm pairs per URL and device setting (200 total page navigations); each pair uses a fresh isolated context with browser cache enabled, cold first navigation, warm immediate same-URL repeat.
manifest.querySanitization: The supplied query value was used for the Dr Walaa profile; all saved resource paths omit query strings and UUID media IDs are replaced with [media-id].
manifest.diagnosticCacheDisabled: Not run; diagnostic cache-disabled navigation was optional and no browser-cache-disabled CDP setting was applied.
manifest.interaction: Lab INP proxy unavailable; no harmless representative action common across the five profiles was established.
manifest.profileShapeDeviation: No-cover/gallery sampling strata were excluded per owner decision; this is a sampling deviation from the broader stratified selection criteria and remains for owner documentation.
manifest.toolLimitations: The host lacked Chrome shared libraries; dependencies were extracted under /tmp and supplied via LD_LIBRARY_PATH. No repository files were changed.
